verdict.rationale: Brex's own product pages say it can "automatically block out-of-policy purchases, with preset rules and limits" and offer "auto-enforced controls" on spend limits. The Budgets API manages Spend Limits, and the Workato docs mention setting monthly limits for users. That covers amount limits and auto-blocking, but nothing in the pack shows restricting cards by merchant category or by specific merchant. missing for 10: documented merchant-category restrictions, specific merchant allow/block lists, explicit point-of-sale decline or card auto-lock mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
